title: Setting Up a Delivery Pipeline for Your Agentic iOS Projects
summary: Donny Wals lays out a delivery loop in which living agent instructions and reviewed plans guide implementation, automated review and CI guard the pull request, and each merge produces a TestFlight build. An iOS team can start by codifying existing conventions, requiring green tests and human device review, then automate the archive-and-upload step once those gates are dependable.
takeaway: Build layered evidence into the path to TestFlight: reviewed plans, local tests, human code and device checks, independent PR review, CI, and a final release build.
